_comment: No composite indexes are required. Every query in the app filters on a
single field (or a single-field 'in'), and narrows further in memory,
which Firestore serves from the automatically-created single-field
indexes. This is deliberate: it means the app works as soon as the
security rules are published, with no separate index deployment step
and no runtime 'query requires an index' failures.
If a future query adds a second where() or an orderBy() on a different
field than the where(), add its composite index here and deploy with:
